title: Candles and Calls
description: Minute candles with the day's top 3 gain windows marked, plus the daily and weekly view and the calls you actually took.

target.queryText:
SELECT MIN(t.executed_ts) AS time,
       i.symbol || ' ' || t.side || ' ' || SUM(t.quantity) || ' @ '
         || printf('%.2f', SUM(t.quantity * t.price) / SUM(t.quantity))
         || CASE WHEN n.sentiment IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' - ' || n.sentiment END
         || CASE WHEN n.note IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ': ' || n.note END AS text,
       t.side || COALESCE(',' || n.sentiment, '') AS tags
FROM trade_note n
JOIN trade t ON t.id = n.trade_id
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
WHERE t.side = 'BUY'
  AND i.symbol = '$symbol'
GROUP BY i.symbol, t.session_date, t.side, COALESCE(t.order_id, 'at' || t.executed_ts), n.sentiment, n.note
ORDER BY MIN(t.executed_ts)
LIMIT 500

panels.title: $symbol - minute candles for the selected sessions (up to $candles candles)
panels.description:
One-minute candles at their real timestamps. Select a single session for an uninterrupted day; several sessions leave a gap where the market was shut.

- **VWAP** (purple) — the day's average price, weighted by the volume traded at each price. The institutional "fair price" benchmark: above it buyers have had control today, below it sellers.
- **SMA 10m / 60m** (yellow, blue) — simple moving averages of the last 10 and 60 one-minute closes. The fast line turns with a move; the slow one says whether that move is with or against the hour.
- **Window entry / exit** (green, red) — the best gain window the detector found. All three windows when a single session is selected.
- **Your buy / sell** (blue, orange dots) — your own fills.
- **Previous close** (dotted) — the last session's closing value, the price today's move is measured from. With several sessions selected each session has its own flat line at its own previous close. It is missing for the earliest stored session, and where the previous session was never stored; the market-day daemon backfills yesterday's session when it starts if the evening batch missed it.

Both averages restart each session and appear only once their window is full, so the 60-minute line begins an hour into the day.

**Volume** (bars, right axis) — shares traded within each one-minute candle.

**Notes** (cyan dashed lines) — your own notes on the chart. Click the chart, press **Add annotation**, write the note (your sentiment, the plan), tag it with this symbol in capitals (for example `RELIANCE`) and a sentiment (`BULLISH`, `BEARISH` or `NEUTRAL`; `BUY` or `SELL` too if you like) and Save. It appears at once, here and on this symbol's other charts, and on the account views if it is tagged `BUY` or `SELL`. Hover its marker to read it. A note without the symbol tag is saved but not drawn.

**Noted calls** (light-blue buys, orange sells; dashed lines) — calls you documented with `trades note`. Hover a marker for the sentiment and your note.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH RECURSIVE scope AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_date) AS sessions
  FROM v_intraday_merged
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
),
-- One session: mark all three windows. Several: only the best of each.
depth AS (SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT sessions FROM scope) = 1 THEN 3 ELSE 1 END AS max_rank),
-- The close of the session before each selected one: the price the day's move is measured from. "Before" is
-- the latest session stored for any symbol, so a hole in this symbol's own history leaves a gap in the line
-- and not a close from several days back.
baseline AS (
  SELECT s.session_date,
         (SELECT t.close
            FROM trading_day t JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
           WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
             AND t.session_date = (SELECT MAX(p.session_date) FROM trading_day p WHERE p.session_date < s.session_date)
           ORDER BY t.interval_minutes LIMIT 1) AS prev_close
  FROM (SELECT session_date FROM trading_day WHERE session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
        UNION
        SELECT session_date FROM live_candle WHERE session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})) s
),
-- How many candles to draw at most: the "Max candles" box. Anything that is not a positive number (blank, text, zero,
-- negative) falls back to 200.
cap AS (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(${candles:sqlstring} AS INTEGER) >= 1 THEN CAST(${candles:sqlstring} AS INTEGER) ELSE 200 END AS n),
-- Every minute candle of the selected sessions, numbered within its session.
mins AS (
  SELECT ts_epoch, session_date, open, high, low, close, volume, vwap, sma10, sma60,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_date ORDER BY ts_epoch) - 1 AS pos
  FROM v_intraday_merged
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
),
sizes AS (SELECT session_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM mins GROUP BY session_date),
-- Minutes per drawn candle: the smallest width that keeps the whole selection within the cap. A candle never
-- spans two sessions, so each session is cut on its own; with room to spare the width is 1, a candle per minute.
widths(w) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT w + 1 FROM widths WHERE w < 400),
width AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MIN(w), 400) AS w FROM widths
  WHERE (SELECT SUM((cnt + w - 1) / w) FROM sizes) <= (SELECT n FROM cap)
),
-- One row per drawn candle: where it starts and ends, and the range and volume of the minutes in it.
candles AS (
  SELECT session_date, pos / (SELECT w FROM width) AS slot,
         MIN(ts_epoch) AS from_ts, MAX(ts_epoch) AS to_ts,
         MAX(high) AS high, MIN(low) AS low, SUM(volume) AS volume
  FROM mins
  GROUP BY session_date, slot
),
-- The marks, read once, then put on the candle whose minutes contain them (the average, if several do).
windows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT entry_ts, exit_ts, entry_price, exit_price FROM v_opportunity_markers
  WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND detector_version = '$detector' AND rank <= (SELECT max_rank FROM depth)
),
fills AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT ts_epoch / 60 * 60 AS minute, side, price FROM v_trade_markers WHERE symbol = '$symbol'
),
entries AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.slot, AVG(w.entry_price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN windows w ON w.entry_ts BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.slot
),
exits AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.slot, AVG(w.exit_price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN windows w ON w.exit_ts BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.slot
),
buys AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.slot, AVG(f.price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN fills f ON f.side = 'BUY' AND f.minute BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.slot
),
sells AS (
  SELECT k.session_date, k.slot, AVG(f.price) AS price
  FROM candles k JOIN fills f ON f.side = 'SELL' AND f.minute BETWEEN k.from_ts AND k.to_ts
  GROUP BY k.session_date, k.slot
)
SELECT k.from_ts AS time,
       -- The tooltip lists series in this order: the candle, then volume, the averages, the previous close, then your marks.
       -- A candle opens where its first minute opened and closes where its last closed; the averages are read at its end.
       f.open  AS open,
       l.close AS close,
       k.high  AS high,
       k.low   AS low,
       k.volume AS volume,
       l.vwap  AS "VWAP",
       l.sma10 AS "SMA 10m",
       l.sma60 AS "SMA 60m",
       -- Blank on the first candle of every session but the first, so the line breaks between sessions
       -- and each one is a flat segment at its own previous close, not a ramp up to the next level.
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(LAG(k.session_date) OVER (ORDER BY k.from_ts), k.session_date) = k.session_date
            THEN base.prev_close END AS "Previous close",
       en.price AS "Window entry",
       ex.price AS "Window exit",
       bu.price AS "Your buy",
       se.price AS "Your sell"
FROM candles k
JOIN mins f ON f.ts_epoch = k.from_ts
JOIN mins l ON l.ts_epoch = k.to_ts
LEFT JOIN baseline base ON base.session_date = k.session_date
LEFT JOIN entries en ON en.session_date = k.session_date AND en.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN exits   ex ON ex.session_date = k.session_date AND ex.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN buys    bu ON bu.session_date = k.session_date AND bu.slot = k.slot
LEFT JOIN sells   se ON se.session_date = k.session_date AND se.slot = k.slot
ORDER BY k.from_ts

panels.title: $symbol - windows found in the selected sessions
panels.description:
What was available, not what you took.

Ranked by gain. The windows never overlap, so these are three distinct opportunities.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT session_date                             AS "Session",
       rank                                     AS "#",
       time(entry_ts,'unixepoch','+5 hours','+30 minutes')                     AS "Entry",
       time(exit_ts,'unixepoch','+5 hours','+30 minutes')                      AS "Exit",
       entry_price                              AS "Buy at",
       exit_price                               AS "Sell at",
       ROUND(gain_pct, 2)                       AS "Gain %",
       duration_minutes                         AS "Held (min)"
FROM v_opportunity_markers
WHERE symbol = '$symbol' AND session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
  AND detector_version = '$detector'
ORDER BY session_date DESC, rank

panels.title: $symbol - every call, newest first

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT t.session_date AS "Date",
       time(t.executed_ts, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AS "Time (IST)",
       t.side       AS "Side",
       t.product    AS "Product",
       t.quantity   AS "Qty",
       t.price      AS "Price",
       t.quantity * t.price AS "Bet amount",
       COALESCE(n.sentiment, '-') AS "Sentiment",
       COALESCE(n.note, '') AS "Note",
       COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(r.reason_code, ', '), '-') AS "Reason"
FROM trade t
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN trade_note n ON n.trade_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN trade_reason r ON r.trade_id = t.id
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol' AND t.session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
GROUP BY t.id
ORDER BY t.executed_ts DESC, t.id DESC
LIMIT 300
targets.queryText:

       t.price      AS "Price",
       t.quantity * t.price AS "Bet amount",
       COALESCE(n.sentiment, '-') AS "Sentiment",
       COALESCE(n.note, '') AS "Note",
       COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(r.reason_code, ', '), '-') AS "Reason"
FROM trade t
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = t.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN trade_note n ON n.trade_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN trade_reason r ON r.trade_id = t.id
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol' AND t.session_date IN (${session:sqlstring})
GROUP BY t.id
ORDER BY t.executed_ts DESC, t.id DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.description:
Your fills in the selected sessions, newest first.

- **Bet amount** — quantity × price, the rupee value of the fill.
- **Reason** — the note recorded against the trade, or "-" if none was.
- **Sentiment** and **Note** — what you recorded about the call when you took it, with `trades note --symbol S --side BUY --sentiment BULLISH --text "..."`. The same note is on every fill of the call, and the sentiment also counts as a reason on the Decision Reasons dashboard.

panels.title: $symbol - weekly candles for the last 6 months, with the calls you took

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT w.ts_epoch AS time,
       w.open  AS open,
       w.high  AS high,
       w.low   AS low,
       w.close AS close,
       w.volume AS volume,
       b.price AS "Buy",
       s.price AS "Sell"
FROM v_weekly_candles w
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, symbol, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'BUY' GROUP BY week, symbol) b
       ON b.week = w.week AND b.symbol = w.symbol
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, symbol, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'SELL' GROUP BY week, symbol) s
       ON s.week = w.week AND s.symbol = w.symbol
WHERE w.symbol = '$symbol'
  AND w.session_date >= date($__from/1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes', '-6 days')
ORDER BY w.session_date
targets.queryText:
SELECT w.ts_epoch AS time,
       w.open  AS open,
       w.high  AS high,
       w.low   AS low,
       w.close AS close,

       s.price AS "Sell"
FROM v_weekly_candles w
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, symbol, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'BUY' GROUP BY week, symbol) b
       ON b.week = w.week AND b.symbol = w.symbol
LEFT JOIN (SELECT strftime('%Y-%W', session_date) AS week, symbol, AVG(price) AS price
             FROM v_trade_markers WHERE side = 'SELL' GROUP BY week, symbol) s
       ON s.week = w.week AND s.symbol = w.symbol
WHERE w.symbol = '$symbol'
  AND w.session_date >= date($__from/1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes', '-6 days')
ORDER BY w.session_date

panels.description:
Always the last 6 months, whatever range the rest of the page is showing.

The **Buy** and **Sell** dots are your fills, averaged over the week the trade happened in.

- **Volume** — shares traded in the week, on the right-hand axis.

panels.title: $symbol - notes written on the charts, and any with no symbol tag

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT datetime(n.noted_at, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AS "When (IST)",
       COALESCE(n.symbol, '(no symbol tag)') AS "Symbol",
       COALESCE(n.sentiment, '-') AS "Sentiment",
       REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(n.tags, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '') AS "Tags",
       COALESCE(n.note, '') AS "Note"
FROM chart_note n
WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL AND (n.symbol = '$symbol' OR n.symbol IS NULL)
ORDER BY n.noted_at DESC, n.grafana_id DESC
LIMIT 200

FROM chart_note n
WHERE n.deleted_at IS NULL AND (n.symbol = '$symbol' OR n.symbol IS NULL)
ORDER BY n.noted_at DESC, n.grafana_id DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.description:
Every note written on a chart for this symbol, newest first, copied from Grafana by `chartnotes sync` (evening.sh runs it). A note with no symbol tag is listed too, as "(no symbol tag)", so none can be lost.

- **Sentiment** — the first tag that is BULLISH, BEARISH or NEUTRAL; a label such as UP or LEVEL counts as the generic one it stands for.
- Give a note with no symbol tag a symbol with `chartnotes assign --id N --symbol S`; it is then drawn on that symbol's charts.

Updated by the market-day daemon every poll while the market is open, by the evening batch after the close. It is the newest of: the last live candle written, the last session ingested, and the last fill imported. If it is much older than a few minutes during market hours, the daemon is not running or cannot reach Groww.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT MAX(t) * 1000 AS "Last data refresh" FROM (
  SELECT MAX(updated_at) AS t FROM live_candle
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(ingested_at) FROM trading_day
  UNION ALL SELECT MAX(imported_at) FROM trade)

panels.title: $symbol - fundamentals, restated at the latest price
panels.description: From the company's page on screener.in, read by `CanSlimMain profiles` (evening.sh does a few each night). **Market cap, P/E, P/B and dividend yield** are restated at the latest price this database holds (today's last candle, else the last session's close) from the figures that do not move with it: earnings per share over the trailing twelve months, book value, the share count and the dividend per share. **Debt / equity** is borrowings over equity capital plus reserves in the latest balance sheet. **ROE, ROCE, book value and face value** are as the page shows them. The 52-week range is this database's own where it has one, else the page's. Empty until the company's page has been read.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ROUND(market_cap_now_cr)       AS "Market cap (₹ Cr)",
       ROUND(pe_now, 1)                 AS "P/E",
       ROUND(pb_now, 2)                 AS "P/B",
       ROUND(debt_to_equity, 2)         AS "Debt / equity",
       ROUND(roe, 2)                    AS "ROE",
       ROUND(roce, 2)                   AS "ROCE",
       ROUND(eps_ttm, 2)                AS "EPS (TTM)",
       ROUND(dividend_yield_now, 2)     AS "Dividend yield",
       ROUND(book_value, 1)             AS "Book value",
       ROUND(face_value, 2)             AS "Face value",
       high_52w                         AS "52-week high",
       low_52w                          AS "52-week low",
       ROUND(pct_from_52w_high, 1)      AS "From 52-week high"
FROM v_company_fundamentals
WHERE symbol = '$symbol'

panels.title: $symbol - revenue and net profit by quarter (₹ crore)
panels.description: The company's latest eight reported quarters, from screener.in. Revenue is its "Sales" line (a bank's "Revenue"); net profit is after tax.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(substr(q.period,6,2) AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || ' ' || substr(q.period,1,4) AS "Quarter",
       q.sales      AS "Revenue",
       q.net_profit AS "Net profit"
FROM company_quarter q
JOIN instrument i ON i.id = q.instrument_id
WHERE i.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY q.period
targets.queryText:
